evidence: Row-specific specification and feasibility pass. The actual workbook Quality Checks!D30 requires both real gates plus an in-dimension hard zero and prohibits a same-origin restriction. Internal Quality Checks!D30 retains older cross-origin wording; the public-network workbook row, skill Delivery profile and current review policy take precedence. Frozen task/tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23 requires incorrect-password refusal followed by correct seeded sign-in into a substantive usable workspace; render/prompt.md:5 expressly requires the positive control. constraints/prompt.md:5-9 and constraints/judge.toml:23-26 require real UI creation of a new requisition and zero-extra PENDING offer, then exact identity/association/value readback through an independently signed-in empty browser context. They reject no-op/static/browser-only saves and a requisition-only app without adding advanced economics to the gate. All scored prompts restate a signed-in UI creation and independent-context requisition readback: functional/prompt.md:9-11 sets every binary result to 0 on gate failure; polish/prompt.md:7-8 does likewise; visual/prompt.md:7-8 uses minimum raw Likert 1, explicitly normalized to zero, consistent with the five-point criteria. No prompt or gate requires same-origin resources. Public instruction.md:9 and integration.md:12-14 allow CDN assets. Prompt alternatives allow generated identifiers, absent title/department controls, ordinary response value representations, and empty starting operational collections. Constraints only samples publicly required direct creation/PENDING behavior (hireops_rules.md:38-39,199-213). Hard-gate wiring is concrete: both gates use binary/all_pass (judge.toml:14-23), scoring.toml:1-3 defines zero thresholds, score.py:40-48 zeros the reward when a gate fails, and test.sh:212-220 stops before the scored suite. Installed parser evidence local/uncached-inspection/configured-inspection/results.json reports resolved context/criteria for all five dimensions; its tests_sha256 entries match current frozen files. Hash verification: all 150 entries of the inspected raw index snapshot matched actual bytes (index SHA256 44a021e35f91308c5a0ac4a377682a94aeb37b49f8280bec70eeb52ef5f6a287). The cited gate-witness/results.json SHA256 is fd8410bc91102874ef98edfdbacf19f7853687956e076acc684d36c565d9ec75 and driver SHA256 is 08ee689584d24a97a8446fb32ca0c4f9d3df100bd6eec14560c4fa63ad8ae31c. The no_op_create variant returned 200 but reqSaved/freshReq/freshOffer/pending were all false (results.json:26-35); golden and dead_approval both created/read back the basic records (lines 4-24). This is the intended separation between a working prerequisite and scored advanced behavior. Real MCP browser_run_code_unsafe independently returned freshContext=true, separateUiLogin=true and the saved $50,000.01 requisition in local/mcp/results.json; all of its sourceBefore hashes match the frozen app and the pinned tool version is 0.0.79. Run scope is PARTIAL: existing finite UI/MCP/parser observations support the gate design and tool feasibility; no new Docker run was necessary. The gate witness does not test every saved field or wrong-password behavior, and is not a configured judge grade. Full configured timing, reward discrimination, Oracle/target scores and portal acceptance remain unmeasured and are not claimed or waived by this row-specific verdict.
counterexample: Broken-app attempt: a backend returning {created:true}/HTTP200 without saving requisitions would fool a health or success-message gate, but the hash-bound no_op_create fixture fails the required independent readback. A static seed copy or browser-local save likewise cannot produce the fresh uniquely created identities; a requisition-only backend fails the required pending offer gate. A dead approval implementation can pass the minimal gate (observed), appropriately leaving approval credit to scored criteria. Conforming-alternative attempt: an app with no imported operational history, generated IDs, no title/department field, ordinary valid money/date formatting, and off-origin fonts/scripts remains permitted by the exact gate wording. No concrete conforming implementation wrongly rejected by this gate was established.
